title: Debug: The Lying Gallery
prompt: Every attribute in this gallery is wrong: the hero carries loading="lazy" (it is the LCP), sizes="100vw" on a 300px card slot, no width/height anywhere (layout shift), and an alt was pasted onto a . Repair: hero gets fetchpriority="high" and no lazy; card sizes says 300px; add intrinsic dimensions to both images; move alt to the only.
boilerplate: Launch gallery

tests.name: hero is eager and high priority
tests.hint: Lazy-loading the LCP image is self-sabotage — swap lazy for fetchpriority="high".

tests.name: card sizes tells the truth
tests.hint: sizes="100vw" makes the browser fetch desktop-sized files for a 300px box.

tests.name: every image has dimensions
tests.hint: The chart image lost its dimensions — restore width and height to stop layout shift.

tests.name: alt only on imgs
tests.hint: alt pasted on a source is dead weight — the img is the one element that carries it.
